official_notes.title: Reliant Stadium
official_notes.note: Texans site: 'Reliant Stadium (previously known as NRG Stadium)'. Capacity not stated on official pages.

official_notes.title: SoFi Stadium
official_notes.note: Official site says 'approximately 70,000, expandable up to 100,000'; Wikipedia's 70,240 kept as the more precise figure.

official_notes.title: U.S. Bank Stadium
official_notes.note: Official history page cites the approved $975 million budget; Wikipedia's $1.061 billion is kept as the reported final cost.

official_notes.title: Ball Arena
official_notes.note: Same official page also says 'seats 19,099 for basketball games and 18,007 for hockey'; the Seating section figures (19,520 / 17,809) are used. Official cost is 'more than $180 million'.

official_notes.title: Delta Center
official_notes.note: Current capacity not stated on official site.

official_notes.title: Intuit Dome
official_notes.note: Official site gives only '18,000 of your closest friends' (marketing copy); Wikipedia's 18,300 kept.

official_notes.title: Toyota Center
official_notes.note: Official arena pages read do not confirm a 2026 WNBA Houston Comets season; tenant comes from Wikipedia's current WNBA teams table.

official_notes.title: Lenovo Center
official_notes.note: Official site gives only 'up to 20,000' across configurations.

official_notes.title: UBS Arena
official_notes.note: Official FAQ says only 'seats over 17,000 fans'.

official_notes.title: Geodis Park
official_notes.note: Official site says '30000 Seats' (rounded); Wikipedia's 30,109 kept.

official_notes.title: Indian Wells Tennis Garden
official_notes.note: Official figure is from the tournament's history page (2000 entry), not a current spec sheet.
